name: Ловля фігури (1)
description: Trapping is a tactic where you limit the mobility of an opponent's piece until it has no safe moves left. Once a piece is trapped, it often becomes an easy target. Look for opponent pieces with limited mobility. By confining such pieces, you can gain material advantage.

examples.text: The black bishop has limited mobility and is trapped by a clever pawn move.
The black knight on b4 is loosely placed and has no way back. White takes advantage of this.
